requirements: Prepare a PATCH release preserving packet 1.0 and 1.1 compatibility and original historical release records.
Freeze exact candidate C; independent source acceptance and disposable prior-release rollback precede actual long-lived Framework self-install.

Before actual installation, preserve existing destination payload, provenance, checkout and owned work, establish safe lane boundary and record C-specific H-CONSUMER-UPGRADE continuation; no reset or hand editing.

Use unchanged official bootstrap with immutable exact SHA and private local prerelease ref. Verify actual checkout HEAD, installed provenance, full inventory/bytes/modes, installed index and entrypoint.
Record independent controller captures and QA. Final metadata commit D must retain payload equality to C. Do not claim production activation or future final tag before publication.
non_goals: No change to packet implementation, consumer schemas, unrelated governance, routing or installed payload by hand.
No production activation, unreviewed mutation, blanket cleanup, or overwrite of owned installation without preservation and safe boundary.
No inferred approval from task labels, prior self-install, source validation or successful exit alone.

evidence_convention: Capture exact commands and stream bytes in existing release evidence family; preserve failures and independently accepted source/controller proof; no invented future SHA.
assurance: High assurance: independent Validator and Evaluator pre-code contract review; independent post-code review and QA; actual destination self-install and release closeout require separate verified evidence.
rollback: Preserve complete current C699 primary payload/provenance and branch/HEAD outside the destination, verify no intervening owned changes and restore via supported process on failure.
